text: Walking into a health centre? Skip the front desk.
asr: Walking into a health center? Skip the front desk.

text: Meet Dawri, the AI front desk for walk-ins.
say: Meet Dow-ree, the AI front desk for walk-ins.
asr: Meet Dowry, the AI front desk for walk-ins.

text: Step one: tell it what's wrong, in Arabic or English, by text or voice.
It asks a few short questions, one at a time.
Step two: pick a health centre, with estimated waits.
asr: Step two: pick a health center, with estimated waits.

text: Step three: when you arrive, tap “I'm here”, and your ticket gets its number.
say: Step three: when you arrive, tap, I'm here, and your ticket gets its number.
asr: Step three: when you arrive, tap I'm here, and your ticket gets its number.

text: Then follow your turn. The nurse already has your answers, and your allergies.
And if it sounds like an emergency, Dawri tells you to call 999. No queue.
say: And if it sounds like an emergency, Dow-ree tells you to call nine nine nine. No queue.
asr: And if it sounds like an emergency, Dowry tells you to call 999. No queue.
